scenes.text: Don't spend five grand on an AI bootcamp, because Microsoft just made a full twelve week course completely free.
So this is AI For Beginners. Twenty four lessons that take you from zero to building real neural networks. Fifty seven thousand stars on GitHub, and Microsoft charges nothing.
So here's the truth. The fundamentals are free now. What people pay for is implementation. Learn this, then build the things clients actually pay for.
I made a free AI starter path to go with it. Comment LEARN and I'll DM you both.
